name: ZoreOutline
description: Narrative structure generator responsible for creating hierarchical outlines of worlds, stories, entities, and systems using deterministic and probabilistic rulesets.

name: ZoreLibrary GUI
description: Graphical interface for browsing, editing, and managing generated lore, entities, and datasets within the ZoreForge ecosystem.

name: Dice Engine

name: Dice Table Scaffold
description: Schema and data-layer framework defining structured dice tables, lookup systems, and generation rules used by the Dice Engine.
